checks.label: AI and search crawlers can read the page
checks.detail: robots.txt lets every major search and AI crawler in.
checks.fix: Blocking training crawlers is a fair choice, but models then learn about you only from other sites. Allow them unless you have a reason not to.

checks.label: Your server or CDN answers AI crawlers
checks.detail: A request naming an AI crawler got the same page as everyone else.
checks.fix: Check your CDN or firewall bot settings (Cloudflare, Vercel, Akamai and others can block AI crawlers by default) and allow the crawlers you want.

checks.label: The page says what you do in plain HTML
checks.detail: The HTML your server sends has about 1758 words of readable text, before any JavaScript runs.
checks.fix: Render your main copy on the server (static or server rendering), aim for 500 words or more, and include one plain sentence: what you are, for whom, and what it does.

checks.label: Structured data says who you are
checks.detail: Organization data found, without a logo, linking 0 other profiles (sameAs).
checks.fix: Add Organization JSON-LD with your name, logo, URL and sameAs links to your LinkedIn, Instagram, Wikipedia or Crunchbase pages. It is how a model tells you apart from a namesake.

checks.label: Structured data describes what you sell
checks.detail: Found AggregateRating, GeoCoordinates, OpeningHoursSpecification, Organization, PostalAddress, ProfessionalService.
checks.fix: Describe what you sell in JSON-LD: Product with price and availability, SoftwareApplication, Service or an ItemList of products. Keep it in step with the visible page.

checks.label: Answers to the questions buyers ask
checks.detail: No questions and answers on the page.
checks.fix: Add a short FAQ with the questions buyers actually ask (price, who it is for, how it compares), answered in a sentence or two, and mark it up as FAQPage.

checks.label: A clear title
checks.detail: "10Clouds - We help build agentic financial institutions" (55 characters).
checks.fix: Write a title of about 30 to 60 characters that names the product and what it is, for example "Acme: booking software for clinics".

checks.label: A meta description that answers "what is this?"
checks.detail: 186 characters: "We help build agentic financial institutions. From credit automation to agentic commerce — workflow orchestration, AI agents, and enterprise…"
checks.fix: Write the meta description as one or two plain sentences of 120 to 160 characters: what you offer and for whom. Engines quote sentences, not keyword lists.

checks.label: One canonical address
checks.fix: Add <link rel="canonical"> with the full preferred address, so every copy of the page credits one URL.

checks.label: The page may be indexed
checks.detail: Nothing tells engines to leave it out.
checks.fix: Remove noindex from the robots meta tag or the X-Robots-Tag header on pages you want found.

checks.label: Headings that outline the page
checks.fix: Give the page one <h1> that says what it is, and <h2> headings for each section, so engines can lift the right passage for a question.

checks.label: An llms.txt for language models
checks.fix: Add /llms.txt: a # title, a one-line summary, and Markdown links to your key pages. It is a proposed standard, so treat it as a cheap bet.

checks.label: A sitemap engines can find
checks.fix: Publish /sitemap.xml listing your important pages and name it in robots.txt with a Sitemap: line.

checks.label: Signs the page is current
checks.detail: Last updated 2 days ago, by the newest date we found.
checks.fix: Keep <lastmod> in your sitemap accurate and add dateModified to your JSON-LD. Engines prefer recent sources, and models answer from stale facts when nothing says what is new.

checks.label: Images described in text
checks.fix: Give every meaningful image alt text that says what it shows (product name, colour, use). Mark decorative images with an empty alt.

checks.label: Link previews (Open Graph)
checks.detail: 3 of og:title, og:description and og:image present.
checks.fix: Add og:title, og:description and og:image, so shared links and cited sources show a proper card.
